assay: bulk total RNA-seq (rRNA-depleted, stranded) of human PBMCs; STAR + featureCounts (S2.7.p2)
sample_inclusion: Young n=7 (2M/5F, 18-30 y) and Old n=8 (4M/4F, 55-80 y); PBMC sampled immediately before and within 1 min after a 60-min interval single-leg knee-extension bout (S2.2.p1, S2.3.p1, S2.5.p1, S2.6.p1); 30 libraries
repeated_measure_unit: participant (pre and post sample from the same person)
primary_estimand: acute-exercise effect (Post vs Pre) on PBMC gene expression, estimated separately within Young and within Old (S3.2.p1; S4.2.p1 'analyses were conducted separately for each age group'); secondary: baseline Old vs Young at Pre (S3.1.p1)
planned_contrasts: Young Post vs Pre (S3.2.p1; paper: 53 DEGs, 52 up / 1 down, of 13,695 genes)
Old Post vs Pre (S3.2.p1; paper: 1,026 DEGs, text lists 359 up / 572 down, of 19,101 genes)
Baseline Old vs Young at Pre (S3.1.p1; paper: 665 DEGs, 446 up / 199 down, of 19,762 genes)
normalization: DESeq2 size factors; genes with zero counts in all samples or fewer than 5 reads in every sample removed (S2.7.p2)
paper_method: DESeq2 1.40.2, apeglm LFC shrinkage (S2.7.p2); design formula and whether pairing was modelled are not stated

paper_threshold.note: S2.8.p1: DEGs at p < 0.01 and FDR < 0.01; afterwards only genes with log2FC beyond the direction-specific mean log2FC were taken to g:Profiler/IPA (a downstream subset, not the DEG rule). S2.7.p2 separately says 5% FDR.

paper_results: Young 53 (52 up, 1 down: SH2D3A); Old 1,026 (359 up, 572 down); baseline 665 (446 up, 199 down); 26 genes shared up in both ages; baseline difference shrinks to 6 genes post-exercise
